replies.body:
I'm going to give honest feedback here.

The shape of the islands are bland, and the gameplay won't be enjoyable because people will not be able to push up these lanes.

The distance to bridge to the monument is ridiculous, and the mind are too close to spawn, keep in mind people are constantly spawning in your way, maybe quicker than you can mine the mon.
